Synopsis:
A nature diary piece describing a walk along the River Nene after a storm. The author observes an unusually lush growth of wetland plants, notably the trifid bur-marigold, attributing it to a combination of abundant water access and prolonged sunshine and warmth this season. The piece briefly notes the plant's nationally vulnerable status due to drainage and land-use changes, and highlights how Nene Park Trust manages cattle grazing with a "Goldilocks" fencing approach to balance ecological needs.
